reason: The cited evidence (E1, E2) reports superconducting properties of specific HEAs but provides no direct support for the key premises linking atomic size mismatch, local lattice distortions, and electron–phonon coupling. E1 mentions electron–phonon coupling for one alloy, and E2 notes that Tc variations cannot be explained by disorder effects, which contradicts the proposed mechanism.
premises: Atomic size mismatch among constituent elements induces local lattice distortions in HEAs.
Local lattice distortions modulate the electron–phonon coupling strength.
Modulation of electron–phonon coupling governs Tc and critical fields in HEAs.
Reducing atomic size mismatch (while keeping electronic character similar) will reduce local distortions.
Reduced local distortions will lower Tc and upper critical field.
